correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the exact source formula and domain. Exact differentiation reduces the claim to \(B(a)-4C(a)\cos(2c)>0\). The half-angle substitution gives \(C(a)>0\) and factors \(B(a)-4C(a)\) through \(F(t)\); the derivative chain through \(G(t)\) proves \(F(t)>0\) for every \(0<t<1\). Boundary cases are explicitly separated, and no finite experiment is used as an infinite-domain proof.

value.rationale: Controlled unitaries form a canonical full Weyl-chamber edge, and effective target size is a published gate-design metric. The source’s common small-target scaling does not order the family. The new theorem gives a complete finite-precision ordering for every admissible cube size and rules out reversals, with CNOT/CPHASE as the unique endpoint maximizer. This is a natural structural classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
